publishedMetadata.description: TanStack Query 5 applied lesson for lab remote task list, featuring a deliberately broken starter, instructor fix, real HTTP/React cache behavior, and security-aware failure handling.
objectives: Integrate RHF/Zod validation, same-origin authenticated-by-nobody teaching POST, Query list/invalidation, conditional status PATCH and explicit error recovery.

Using the actual loopback API and installed RHF/Query, prove valid create→GET refresh, invalid title no-POST, 422/error retry, 412 version conflict and a rollback path in the companion task workspace.
The teaching API is in-memory and unauthenticated. Do not deploy this workflow publicly or imply that Zod/client query keys provide access control.
